about_short_description.short_description: Mohandes Insurance provides all kinds of insurance, such as general, marine, and goods insurance.

product.name: Fire Insurance Policy
product.description: Provides coverage for insured properties (buildings and contents) against fire damage and related risks.

product.name: Burglary Insurance Policy
product.description: Covers losses and damages to contents caused by theft involving violence or force.

product.name: Political Violence Property Insurance Policy
product.description: Compensates for material damages to insured properties caused by political violence and related events.

product.name: Comprehensive Multi-Risk Insurance Policy
product.description: Offers combined coverage for multiple risks including fire, burglary, and other specified perils under one policy.

product.name: Industrial All Risks Insurance Policy
product.description: Covers losses or damages to industrial assets from a wide range of accidental risks including fire, explosion, and machinery breakdown.

identifier.value: Comprehensive Hotel and Tourist Village Insurance Policy

product.name: Comprehensive Hotel and Tourist Village Insurance Policy
product.description: Provides insurance coverage tailored for hotels, tourist villages, and resorts against various risks affecting property and operations.
